subject.note: The retained release executable is the measured subject. Later concurrent source-only preflight work is not included; no rebuild occurs during this capture.

protocol.object_twins: Assemble the first two compiles per arm, require full-byte equality within and across arms using existing S1 helpers; report S1 text, rodata, padding and literal data separately.
protocol.steps: One additional identity compilation per input with --pass-report=<new path>; require DEFINED_MATCH and report exact before/after interpreter steps. This report-producing compile is excluded from compile-cost samples.
protocol.metric: Median host release compiler spawn-to-stdio-drain wall time per input; deterministic size and steps separately. No program timing, A/A or A/B latency campaign.
protocol.attempts: One capture, no warmups, retries or tuning after results. A missing tool/failed compile remains an explicit failure. Ratios above the frozen bound remain BOUND_NOT_MET, not a reason to rerun.
protocol.serialization: No Cargo, native corpus, container or other measurement runs concurrently. Reuse existing Capture and S1 helpers; no new runner/audit layer.

resources.retention: Capture commands, hashes, S1 numbers and pass reports. Delete explicitly owned assembly/object intermediates after measurement; record retained bytes.

disposition: This bounds the identity wiring only on two already-existing supported inputs. Opaque S5 library units and the integer-mix source-bridge mismatch remain NOT_ADMITTED. No optimizer is promoted, regardless of ratios. A resource bound miss closes this measurement negatively and leaves identity development-only.
claim_ceiling: No universal equivalence, application performance, full-source-bridge, six-TU optimizing-pass admission or certified EqSat claim.
